description: #566: lone UTF-16 surrogate escapes in an ls_identity revelation token's certificate JSON, with parseResults' outcome and, where read, the fields as the reference holds them and as TextEncoder writes them
subject: 03acd484e2f0c7f65309ad178a9f559abde09796974c57e714c35f110dfc27ccbe

cases.name: control
cases.check: the reference's own record, no surrogate

cases.name: field_value_high
cases.check: an unrevealed field value ending in a lone high surrogate: TextEncoder writes U+FFFD, the signature over it

cases.name: field_value_low
cases.check: an unrevealed field value opening with a lone low surrogate

cases.name: field_value_high_then_non_low
cases.check: a high surrogate followed by a unit that is no low surrogate

cases.name: field_value_reversed_pair
cases.check: a low surrogate before a high one: two lone units

cases.name: field_value_upper_case_escape
cases.check: the escape in upper case, JSON's other spelling

cases.name: field_name
cases.check: an unrevealed field name carrying a lone surrogate

cases.name: revealed_field_name
cases.check: a revealed field name carrying a lone surrogate: the keyring name matches it unit for unit and its key ID derives from TextEncoder's bytes

cases.name: keyring_value
cases.check: a keyring value carrying a lone surrogate: not base64, the anyone decryption fails

cases.name: keyring_name_not_a_field
cases.check: a keyring name whose lone unit differs from the field's: no field of that name, :122-125

cases.name: field_names_two_lone_units
cases.check: two field names differing only in their lone unit: one name each, the same TextEncoder bytes in the binary twice

cases.name: field_names_lone_and_replacement
cases.check: a field name with a lone unit beside one with U+FFFD itself

cases.name: field_names_lone_and_private_use
cases.check: a field name with a lone unit beside one with U+E000: ICU sorts the lone unit before U+E000, U+FFFD after it

cases.name: member_name
cases.check: a ninth member named by a lone surrogate, :100-105

cases.name: type
cases.check: type no canonical base64, Certificate.ts:233

cases.name: serial_number
cases.check: serialNumber no canonical base64, Certificate.ts:237

cases.name: subject
cases.check: subject no key, the locking key's counterparty, :528-533

cases.name: certifier
cases.check: certifier no key, Certificate.ts:240-254

cases.name: revocation_outpoint
cases.check: revocationOutpoint no 64-hex txid, Certificate.ts:260-270

cases.name: signature
cases.check: signature no hex, Certificate.ts:434

cases.name: revealed_field_value
cases.check: a revealed field value carrying a lone surrogate, signed: no canonical base64, the anyone decryption fails (VerifiableCertificate.ts:187-191)
